idea-plugin.name: imprfct Keymap macOS
idea-plugin.description:
A macOS keymap for JetBrains Rider, based on ReSharper (macOS), with direct tab switching and structural text selection.

  • Cmd+W: close the current tab.
  • Cmd+1 through Cmd+9: select the corresponding editor tab.
  • Option+W: extend selection.
  • Option+Shift+W: shrink selection.

After installation, select imprfct Keymap macOS in Settings > Keymap.

Other shortcuts are inherited from ReSharper (macOS). Cmd+1 through Cmd+9 are removed from tool-window actions to avoid conflicts.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release with tab navigation, closing the current tab, and extending or shrinking selection.
